title: Tidey Whitey | 30A Escapes
meta_description: BEACH ACCESS UPDATE: Due to Hurricane Isaias, direct beach access for this property is temporarily unavailable. Nearby public beach access points remain available for guests to enjoy during their stay. We appreciate your understanding as our community continues to recover.
description_expanded: Description Description BEACH ACCESS UPDATE: Due to Hurricane Isaias, direct beach access for this property is temporarily unavailable. Nearby public beach access points remain available for guests to enjoy during their stay. We appreciate your understanding as our community continues to recover.30A ESCAPES presents…“Tidey Whitey,” a luxurious Seacrest Beach retreat featuring a private heated pool, spa and a charming carriage house. Accommodating up to 14 guests, this home offers a chef’s kitchen with top-tier appliances, multiple living areas and expansive porches overlooking the pool. Located near Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach, it's the perfect destination for families or groups seeking a premium 30A getaway.*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Private Heated Pool & Spa: Enjoy a spacious 34x16 ft private pool with a bubbling spa, perfect for spending sunny afternoonsPrivate Carriage House: Enjoy additional accommodations with a King Suite, bunk room, full kitchen and comfortable living areaChef's Kitchen: Prepare everything from casual breakfasts to family dinners in a beautifully appointed kitchen featuring quartz countertops, high-end appliances and spacious 8-foot island.Multiple Living Areas: Plenty of room to spread out with an open-concept living area, second-floor loft and additional living space in the carriage house.Outdoor Kitchen & Grill: Make the most of evenings outdoors with a dedicated grilling and food preparation area, perfect for cooking and entertaining.Furnished Outdoor Living Spaces: Enjoy a screened-in porch with comfortable seating, a flat-screen TV and outdoor dining, plus additional gathering spaces by the private pool.7 Beach Bikes Included: Explore Scenic Highway 30A and its neighboring communitiesEager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐"The property was exactly as described—spacious & clean. Perfect for large groups!" – Michael S.⭐"Beautiful home with excellent amenities. We loved the pool and proximity to shops and restaurants!" – Jenna L.⭐"Tidey Whitey was everything we hoped for—a relaxing and luxurious getaway. Highly recommend!" – Amir R.*** LIVING AREAS ***Step inside “Tidey Whitey” and discover beautiful living spaces where coastal charm meets modern comfort. This thoughtfully designed home features inviting furnishings and plenty of room for everyone to gather. Whether you're spending the evening watching a movie in the living room, enjoying a quiet afternoon in the upstairs loft or relaxing in the carriage house, there's a comfortable place for everyone.Main Living Area: Open-concept design featuring comfortable seating, a large TV and coastal furnishings.Second-Floor Loft: Additional living space with cozy couches and a Smart TV, perfect for movie nights and relaxing or giving younger guests their own place to hang out.Carriage House Living Area: Separate, comfortable living space with modern furnishings and a full kitchen, providing convenience for guests staying in the carriage house.*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***Whether you're preparing a quick breakfast before heading out or gathering everyone for a homemade dinner, the beautifully appointed chef's kitchen makes cooking and entertaining a pleasure. Premium appliances, quartz countertops and a spacious island provide everything for preparing meals throughout your stay. Gather around the dining table for family dinners or take advantage of the outdoor kitchen for an evening of grilling and dining together.Chef's Kitchen: Beautifully designed with quartz countertops, a premium Sub-Zero refrigerator, Wolf range and farmhouse sink.Spacious Kitchen Island: An impressive 8-foot island provides plenty of room for meal preparation, serving and gathering while dinner is being prepared.Dining Area: Enjoy a spacious dining table with room for gathering over homemade meals and spending time together.Outdoor Kitchen: Dedicated grilling and preparation area makes outdoor cooking and entertaining easy.Carriage House Kitchen: A separate full kitchen with modern appliances offers added convenience for guests staying in the carriage house.*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***With accommodations for up to 14 guests, “Tidey Whitey” offers a wonderful layout for larger families and groups traveling together. The main house features four beautifully appointed bedrooms spread across two floors. For guests seeking additional privacy, the separate carriage house provides a King Suite and bunk room of its own. Thoughtfully arranged sleeping accommodations make it easy for everyone to enjoy time together while still having a comfortable space to retreat at the end of the day.1st Floor:Primary King Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV and En-suite with dual vanities, soaking tub & walk-in showerHalf Bathroom: Conveniently located off the kitchen2nd Floor:Half Bathroom: Conveniently located off the living areaKing Guest Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV and En-suite with single vanity & walk-in showerKing Guest Bedroom: King bed, flat-screen TV and En-suite with single vanity & shower/tub comboBunk Room: 2 Twin-over-Twin bunk beds, offering comfortable sleeping accommodations 4Carriage HouseKing Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV and En-suite with dual vanities & walk-in shower.Bunk Nook: Twin-over-Twin bunk beds, offering additional accommodations for 2*** OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ***The outdoor spaces at “Tidey Whitey” are designed for enjoying every part of your day along 30A. Start your morning with coffee on the front porch, settle into the screened-in porch for a little relaxation or spend the afternoon lounging beside the private pool and spa. With multiple outdoor dining areas, a covered kitchen for grilling and plenty of room for everyone to spread out, the backyard is perfect for a quiet afternoon or an evening spent together. Guests staying in the carriage house can even enjoy their own balcony, complete with a cozy bistro table.Private Pool & Spa: Enjoy a spacious 34x16 ft private swimming pool and bubbling spa, perfect for relaxing and spending time together.Poolside Lounging & Dining: Relax on one of 6 poolside loungers, enjoy an outdoor meal at the dining table for 4 or take advantage of the grassy play area beside the pool.Screened-In Outdoor Living: A beautifully furnished side porch offers comfortable lounge seating, a flat-screen TV and an al fresco dining table for 6, perfect for enjoying meals and evenings outdoors.Covered Outdoor Kitchen: Conveniently located off the pool deck, this outdoor cooking space features a gas grill and mini refrigerator, making poolside meals and entertaining easy.Inviting Front Porch: Adirondack chairs provide a comfortable place to enjoy your morning coffeeCarriage House Balcony: A private balcony with a bistro table for 2 offers a charming spot for morning coffee or a quiet evening outdoors.Outdoor Shower: Rinse off and refresh with the convenience of an outdoor shower.*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Located in Seacrest Beach along Scenic Highway 30A, “Tidey Whitey” offers a wonderful home base for exploring some of the area's most loved coastal communities. Hop on one of the 7 included bikes and spend the afternoon discovering local boutiques, grabbing lunch at a favorite restaurant or enjoying the beautiful architecture and charming streets of nearby Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach. With plenty of dining, shopping and entertainment options throughout the area, there's always something new to discover during your stay.Alys Beach: Explore this coastal community known for its iconic white architecture, beautifully landscaped surroundings and exceptional dining experiences.Rosemary Beach: Wander through charming streets lined with boutique shops and local restaurants.The Big Chill: Enjoy a lively gathering place featuring restaurants, shopping, live music and family-friendly entertainment.*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independentlyWe do NOT accept wire transfers for paymentPool heating is available seasonally from September 1 through April 30.Waiver required to get access to the 7 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A EscapesThis is not an event-friendly property.*** YOUR STAY – OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we are committed to delivering a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and a professionally maintained home designed for connection, relaxation, and unforgettable beachside memories.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 99614STRO #: STR-099614 Read less
